title: After pest attack, Negros pins hope on new sugarcane variety
summary: BACOLOD CITY—The provincial government of Negros Occidental has expanded its sugarcane recovery program through the production and distribution of a new high-yielding sugarcane variety developed by…

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—The provincial government of Negros Occidental has expanded its sugarcane recovery program through the production and distribution of a new high-yielding sugarcane variety developed by the Philippine Sugar Research Institute Foundation Inc. (Philsurin) that promises to be more resistant to the red-striped soft-scale insect (RSSI) that damaged a large expanse of farms this year.
